description: Baseline workspace settings with the embedder switched to text-embedding-3-small (OpenAI-compatible, through the guard), documents re-embedded. Measured with EMBEDDING_MODEL_MAX_CHUNK_LENGTH=8191, which AnythingLLM also uses as the chunk size, so chunks grew from ~900 to ~6200 chars: two changes, not one. Larger chunks favour document-level recall, so the reranker's lead over it is conservative.
embedder: text-embedding-3-small via llm-api-guard (chunks up to 8191 chars, 20 overlap)
